storagehelper.button.deposit.tooltip: Move matching items from your inventory and hotbar into this container. Shift-scroll DOWN deposits; UP over your inventory returns the remembered deposit.
storagehelper.button.sort.tooltip: Rearrange this container using the selected order. Your inventory is not sorted.
storagehelper.sortmode.tooltip.by_type: Tools & weapons, armor, ores & minerals, food & drinks, blocks, redstone, then everything else. Alphabetical within each group.
storagehelper.status.cursor_not_empty: Put down the item on your cursor first
storagehelper.status.sort.bundles_full: Bundles need one empty chest slot to sort
storagehelper.scroll.controls: Shift-scroll DOWN over your inventory to deposit; UP over the container to withdraw (2 items/unit). UP anywhere in your inventory returns the last deposit; DOWN in the container returns the last withdrawal.
storagehelper.preview.unavailable: No contents reported: empty or unavailable
storagehelper.bundle.hint: Click an entry; scroll for more.
storagehelper.bundle.extract: Left-click to take this stack to an empty cursor using vanilla bundle selection and right-click.
storagehelper.bundle.limited: Read-only: outside vanilla’s selectable entries. Remove earlier stacks first.
storagehelper.bundle.readonly: Read-only preview in the creative inventory.
storagehelper.button.cancel.tooltip: Cancel the current operation and safely return its cursor stack.
storagehelper.search.tooltip: Search container item names or registry IDs. Click to edit; Escape leaves the field.
storagehelper.button.player_sort.tooltip: Sort only your 27 main storage slots using the selected order. Hotbar, armor, offhand, and crafting slots stay untouched. Click again to cancel.
